lead_panel_before_after.caveat_on_the_comparison: BEFORE and AFTER come from the same script on the same 9 routes 51 minutes apart, so the comparison is like-for-like in shape. It is still two single runs against live data, not a controlled benchmark: the request counts are n9 warm / n6 cold per route as the script sets them, and no claim is made about variance beyond the printed min and max.
